observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel freestanding cooker with four gas burners on grates, two electric hotplates in the center, a raised glass splashback, and control knobs on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker with four gas burners lit with blue flames; the electric hotplates are off and the splashback is raised.
Photo 2 shows the same cooker with the glass lid closed flat, a row of control knobs along the front panel, and an oven door with a glass window below.

identity.kind: freestanding cooker with 4 gas burners and 2 electric hotplates

claims.claim: 4 gas burners and 2 burners making 6 burners in total
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows four gas burners and two electric hotplates
photo 1 shows gas burners lit, but the oven and electric hotplates are not shown operating

risks.risk: Oven does not heat or thermostat is faulty
risks.proof: video of the oven turned on and reaching temperature

risks.risk: Two electric hotplates do not heat
risks.proof: video of each electric hotplate switched on and heating

risks.risk: Gas burners have ignition or gas supply faults not visible in still photos
risks.proof: video of each gas burner igniting individually and holding a steady flame

risks.risk: Control knobs or gas valves are stiff, broken, or leaking
risks.proof: close-up video of knobs turning and gas connections

proof_requests: Video of the oven heating up
Video of both electric hotplates switching on and heating
Video of each gas burner igniting individually
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 4-gas-plus-2-electric freestanding cooker, and the unproven "works perfectly" claim can be priced at worst case without needing more photos.
